launch_after: All 150 frozen fits and successor report have completed, original saved-evidence audit passes, and the execution source matches this SHA256.
scope: Independent CPU replay of all selected D27 models on all original eligible development VAL blocks. No model selection, optimization, normalization refit or external-test access.

model.direct_operations: Weight normalization from weight_g/weight_v, conv1d, GELU, gated tanh/sigmoid, per-layer and per-cycle residual scales, skip accumulation, final linear convolution.

evaluation.targets: Original envelope values in float64 for scoring
evaluation.outcome: Finish all six cases even if numerical tolerances fail; preserve every failed block and report execution_completed separately from strict_all_metrics_passed.

cost_accounting.formal_model_calls: Count all independent forward invocations and exact input sample-time presentations including halos.
cost_accounting.checkpoint_reads: 150 successful tensor decodes; separate load attempts and decoded file sizes.
cost_accounting.data: 294 EEG record passes; actual EEG sample-time reads and scored target sample-time presentations, not global unions.
cost_accounting.first_draft_synthetic_CPU_and_wall: Unknown, retained as null; final verification timing recorded in preparation receipt.

safety.existing_output_directory: Refuse; no overwrite or silent resume.
safety.failure: Preserve completed case receipts, actual counters and failure evidence; no automatic retry.
safety.metric_failure: Do not change tolerance or retrain.

remaining: Actual execution after the full matrix is complete
Independent inspection of per-block discrepancies and actual exit evidence
Rendered figure review and scientific interpretation
Independent generalization/SOTA evidence outside these repeated development scores
